D.reason: Unambiguous execution rules (sum of absolute weight changes at most 4%/day, explicit three-trade-day fallback, closes only) plus an 8% vol target, graded trend filter, cash fallback for 2022-style regimes and a governor at 10% use the drawdown budget sensibly for growth with minimal complexity; the only gap is unspecified overflow when the Treasury sink hits its 25% cap.
